additions.evidence: Official announcement specifies magnetic switches and adjustable actuation. Regional availability planned Q3/Q4 2026; shipping not established in this pass.
Manufacturer explicitly calls this a magnetic gaming keyboard; ordinary Origins 2 65/1800 and Alloy Rise excluded.
Manufacturer specifies next-generation analog inductive switches with adjustable actuation and Rapid Trigger.
Manufacturer specifies 60% layout with analog inductive switches. Regional layouts/colorways combined.
Official page describes full analog keypad control through Aimpad; inclusion does not establish HallJoy protocol support.

Manufacturer specifies Aimpad analog control. Hands-on review confirms Q W E R A S D F subset: https://www.pcworld.com/article/398139/cooler-master-mk850-review.html . Not all keys analog; not Logitech MK850.
Official support and keyboard catalog identify Hall Effect switches. ANSI/ISO/JIS combined.
Manufacturer catalog explicitly names Hall Effect magnetic keyboard, distinct from TKL.
Official specs: 87-key magnetic keyboard. Bruce Lee 85th and Something editions consolidated under base model; switch/artwork differences do not establish a new base model.
